statements.statement: The patient has a documented history of known sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The diagnosis codes I49.5 and I48.91 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to guide management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy
